title: NBA: Doncic leads Lakers past Hawks, Wemby sparks Spurs
summary: Luka Doncic scored 32 points as the in-form Los Angeles Lakers rolled to a sixth straight victory with a 124-114 defeat of the Atlanta Hawks on Monday.
